results.title: Ghosthing
results.overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

results.title: Home Sweet Home
results.overview: Struggling to find his place during his first year at university, a lonely international student finds comfort in an unexpected conversation that reshapes the way he perceives home and belonging.

The events depicted in the film embody the spirit, determination, and self-sacrifice of a generation that stood up to defend the Homeland, as exemplified by the special forces. At the center of the plot stand Special Forces officer Rashad Khalilov, Zeynep Ozdemir—a Turkish orthopedic surgeon working in Azerbaijan—and Colonel Ramazan Karimov, commander of the special operations group.

results.title: Drain Flies
results.overview: Just released from prison, Gus is looking for a fresh start; his brother Charlie, however, has other ideas - weaponising Gus's "ex-con" rep for his own ends.

results.title: Айтматов
results.overview: An upcoming biopic on world-renowned Kyrgyz author Chingiz Aitmatov. The film traces his childhood, losing his father, and the personal struggle that shaped his literary voice—from humble beginnings to becoming the voice of his nation.

results.title: Rebound
results.overview: Dee rebounds from one, funny failed date to the next, in the search for Mr Right. If only she could see that her best friend is right there all along - it's obvious, right?

results.title: Contumazá
results.overview: A contemplative gaze toward the town of Contumazá, in the northern highlands of Peru. Beginning with a murder that occurred a century ago involving the director’s great grandfather, the film reflects on the passage of time through the daily routine of her mother, conversations about an event that is almost forgotten, and the faces of the townspeople. The landscapes and traditions of the town gradually reveal the beauty, solitude, and poetry of its inhabitants.

results.title: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport
results.original_title: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport
results.overview: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport is a Thriller/Horror story based off the Wattpad Webstory by PRNCSPLM also known as Chase Pulumbarit, adapted by Aliah Dela Cruz.

results.title: The Last Goodbye: Not Just Yet!
results.original_title: The Last Goodbye: Not Just Yet
results.overview: Based off the Wattpad Series by PRNCSPLM the third book in the series following The Both Sides Of Me. The last and final year of Junior High in 10 Sapphire everything changes when Chase's Ex Mackzyn transfers in his school and his section.

results.title: Jebediah: Are We OK?
results.overview: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.

results.title: Bapak Paling Jujur
results.overview: A highly calculated gubernatorial candidate finds his meticulously engineered political campaign and public persona thrown into absolute disarray when a maternal curse renders him entirely incapable of deception, forcing him to navigate the political arena with unfiltered, absolute honesty.

results.title: Low Tide
results.overview: A retirement home by the sea. A storm is brewing. Élodie, 11, visits her grandmother Ismène, who seems lost in the fog of her memories. The young girl fights back against fate with a few notes of music. The fog begins to lift.

results.title: After the Curtain Falls
results.overview: After joining a school theatre production to cope with a shaky home life, Cole is forced to deal with his trauma directly after a tragic event blurs the lines between art and reality.

results.title: Ruki Vverh! 2
results.overview: Thirty years after the story of the band Ruki Vverkh! began, Sergey Zhukov together with his children revisits memories of his youth: his first love, his first big dreams, friendship, family, and the journey to the stage.

results.title: As I am now, so shall you be
results.overview: An anxious mother is searching for her missing daughter while she deals with her deepest fears about her child's safety.

results.title: Phantasmagoria
results.overview: Leo tries to come to terms with having lost his best friend Olivia. Through his stream of consciousness, memories become unearthed and a shadow of her haunts him.

results.title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
results.overview: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

results.title: Where's Your Sunset Spot?
results.overview: David, a gay high school senior, embarks on an end-of-summer road trip with his best friend Annie. Along the way, he begins to question what he thought he understood about his identity.

results.title: Whitewater Inc.
results.overview: A total loser has a bad day at work.
